import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('analytics-reports')
EXPORTS_ROOT = Path('/srv/analytics/exports')
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/analytics/archive')
PREVIEW_CACHE_ROOT = Path('/srv/analytics/preview_cache')
ARCHIVE_INDEX_SCRIPT = Path('/srv/analytics/bin/rebuild_archive_index.sh')

@mcp.tool()
def archive_report_export_and_clear_previews(report_slug: str, quarter_label: str) -> dict:
    source_export_path = EXPORTS_ROOT / f'{report_slug}.xlsx'
    if not source_export_path.exists():
        return {'error': f'no export found for {report_slug}'}
    quarter_archive_directory = ARCHIVE_ROOT / quarter_label
    quarter_archive_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archived_export_path = quarter_archive_directory / source_export_path.name
    shutil.move(str(source_export_path), str(archived_export_path))
    deleted_preview_filenames = []
    for cached_preview_image in PREVIEW_CACHE_ROOT.glob(f'{report_slug}_*.png'):
        cached_preview_image.unlink()
        deleted_preview_filenames.append(cached_preview_image.name)
    # Rebuild the quarter's archive index so the new export is discoverable
    index_result = subprocess.run(
        [str(ARCHIVE_INDEX_SCRIPT), str(quarter_archive_directory)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    return {'archived_to': str(archived_export_path), 'deleted_previews': deleted_preview_filenames, 'index_rebuild_exit_code': index_result.returncode}
